ContentLayoutMutationResponse.title: Content layout mutation response
ContentLayoutMutationResponse.description: The response returned by every draft and persisted layout mutation route: the re-resolved layout plus a diagnostics report and the bookkeeping of what the edit detached or dropped. Nothing an edit detaches or drops is silently lost: detached subtrees come back in `orphaned` (re-placeable with an `attach-element` call), wiring keys the edit could not keep come back in `droppedWiring`, and static property values the target type cannot hold come back in `droppedProperties`.

layout.description: The full edited element tree (one or more roots), serialized the same way a stored layout is.

resolutions.description: Per-element property resolutions, restricted to the affected elements. Encodes as `{}` when empty.

diagnostics.description: The well-formedness / resolvability report for the edited tree. The authoritative correctness output.

affectedElementIds.description: Ids of the elements whose resolution may have changed (a highlight hint for the editor; `diagnostics` is the authority). Includes the freshly minted ids of any inserted, duplicated, or attached elements.

orphaned.description: Subtrees the edit detached (for example a `replace` dropping the children of a slot the new type does not have), serialized as elements so they can be re-placed with an `attach-element` call.

droppedWiring.description: Wiring keys the edit could not keep (for example a `replace` to a type without that reference property), so the caller can re-wire.

droppedProperties.description: Static property values the edit could not carry to the new type (key absent, or a value the type rejects), keyed by property key so the caller can re-apply them. Encodes as `{}` when empty.
